name: VCK-2 17T@1M deterministic virtual vector program
semantics: Each lane evaluates one deterministic virtual FP32 multiply then add (two FLOP-equivalent operations). Full 4096-lane commands cover 8,499,200 lanes and one 800-lane tail covers the final 800 lanes.
floatSemantics: FP32 after input conversion, FP32 after multiply, FP32 after add; outputs serialized IEEE-754 little-endian float32.
availabilityBoundary: The 17 TFLOP/s-eq figure is represented deterministic compute availability at a 1 MHz epoch rate. It is not conventional measured hardware TFLOPS unless every represented operation is physically executed in real time.
